config.label: Base-network wallet private key (0x-prefixed, 64 hex chars)
config.description: Base-network wallet private key (0x-prefixed, 64 hex chars). Fund the wallet with a small amount of USDC on Base to pay $0.002 per call. Create one at https://app.coinbase.com or any Base-compatible wallet.

config.label: Optional cap on per-call price in USD (default 0
config.description: Optional cap on per-call price in USD (default 0.01). Requests that would cost more than this are rejected without payment.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Without it, skim_read works on a shared free tier — no signup, no key. Add a Base wallet private key (use a fresh, low-balance agent wallet) to unlock paid tools (skim_extract, skim_signals) via per-call x402 USDC payments at fixed prices ($0.002/$0.005/$0.015). Used per-request only, never stored. Card-payment alternative: https://apify.com/jessiejanie/skim-clean-reader
